title: Lookalike Verbs: 切る or 着る?
description: Pairs that sound alike but conjugate differently — type the right form in context.

points.title: う-verbs that look like る-verbs
points.summary: Lookalike verbs: Verbs that sound the same (or almost) but belong to different types.
points.body:
- **切る** (cut) is an う-verb → 切って, 切らない — **着る** (wear) is a る-verb → 着て, 着ない.
- **帰る** (go home) → 帰って, 帰らない — **変える** (change) → 変えて, 変えない.
- **要る** (need) → 要らない — **いる** (be) → いない.
- **入る** (enter) → 入って — **入れる** (put in) → 入れて.
- **知る**, **走る**, **喋る**, **滑る**, **焦る**, **減る** look like る-verbs but are う-verbs.

Tip: learn each exception together with its ない-form (帰らない, 知らない) — that form gives the type away.
examples: {美容院|びよういん}で{髪|かみ}を{短|みじか}く切りました。
I had my hair cut short at the salon.

points.title: Real る-verbs (the lookalike partners)
points.summary: Lookalike verbs: Verbs that sound the same (or almost) but belong to different types.
points.body:
- **切る** (cut) is an う-verb → 切って, 切らない — **着る** (wear) is a る-verb → 着て, 着ない.
- **帰る** (go home) → 帰って, 帰らない — **変える** (change) → 変えて, 変えない.
- **要る** (need) → 要らない — **いる** (be) → いない.
- **入る** (enter) → 入って — **入れる** (put in) → 入れて.
- **知る**, **走る**, **喋る**, **滑る**, **焦る**, **減る** look like る-verbs but are う-verbs.

Tip: learn each exception together with its ない-form (帰らない, 知らない) — that form gives the type away.
examples: {寒|さむ}かったので、コートを着ました。
It was cold, so I wore a coat.

questions.prompt:
{美容院|びよういん}で{髪|かみ}を{短|みじか}く（　）。
→ {切|き}る (cut) · polite past
questions.explanation: {切|き}る is an う-verb (godan): る → り (い-row) for the ます-stem, then add the ending → **切りました**. ⚠ {切|き}る ends in -iる like a る-verb, but it is one of the う-verb exceptions.
questions.translation: I had my hair cut short at the salon.

questions.prompt:
{寒|さむ}かったので、コートを（　）。
→ {着|き}る (wear) · polite past
questions.explanation: {着|き}る is a る-verb (ichidan): drop る for the ます-stem, then add the ending → **着ました**.
questions.translation: It was cold, so I wore a coat.

questions.prompt:
{玉|たま}ねぎを{細|こま}かく（　）ください。
→ {切|き}る (cut) · please do … (てください)
questions.explanation: {切|き}る is an う-verb (godan): う・つ・る → って + ください → **切ってください**. ⚠ {切|き}る ends in -iる like a る-verb, but it is one of the う-verb exceptions.

questions.prompt:
{結婚式|けっこんしき}で{着物|きもの}を（　）{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}った。
→ {着|き}る (wear) · て-form
questions.explanation: {着|き}る is a る-verb (ichidan): drop る + て / た → **着て**.
questions.translation: I wore a kimono at the wedding and had photos taken.

questions.prompt:
{彼|かれ}はもう{家|いえ}に（　）よ。
→ {帰|かえ}る (go home) · plain past
questions.explanation: {帰|かえ}る is an う-verb (godan): う・つ・る → って → **帰った**. ⚠ {帰|かえ}る ends in -eる like a る-verb, but it is one of the う-verb exceptions.

questions.prompt:
{髪|かみ}の{色|いろ}を{明|あか}るく（　）。
→ {変|か}える (change) · plain past
questions.explanation: {変|か}える is a る-verb (ichidan): drop る + て / た → **変えた**.
questions.translation: I changed my hair to a lighter colour.

questions.prompt:
{雨|あめ}は{降|ふ}らないから、{傘|かさ}は（　）よ。
→ {要|い}る (need) · plain negative
questions.explanation: {要|い}る is an う-verb (godan): る → ら (あ-row) + ない → **要らない**. ⚠ {要|い}る ends in -iる like a る-verb, but it is one of the う-verb exceptions.
questions.translation: It won't rain, so you don't need an umbrella.

questions.prompt:
{兄|あに}は{今|いま}、{家|いえ}に（　）よ。
→ いる (be (people)) · plain negative
questions.explanation: いる is a る-verb (ichidan): drop る + ない → **いない**.
questions.translation: My brother isn't at home right now.

questions.prompt:
どうぞ、{中|なか}に（　）ください。
→ {入|はい}る (enter) · please do … (てください)
questions.explanation: {入|はい}る is an う-verb (godan): う・つ・る → って + ください → **入ってください**. ⚠ {入|はい}る ends in -iる like a る-verb, but it is one of the う-verb exceptions.

questions.prompt:
{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}を{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}に（　）ください。
→ {入|い}れる (put in) · please do … (てください)
questions.explanation: {入|い}れる is a る-verb (ichidan): drop る + て / た + ください → **入れてください**.
questions.translation: Please put the milk in the fridge.

questions.prompt:
その{人|ひと}の{名前|なまえ}は（　）。
→ {知|し}る (know) · plain negative
questions.explanation: {知|し}る is an う-verb (godan): る → ら (あ-row) + ない → **知らない**. ⚠ {知|し}る ends in -iる like a る-verb, but it is one of the う-verb exceptions.
questions.translation: I don't know that person's name.

questions.prompt:
{毎朝|まいあさ}{公園|こうえん}を（　）。
→ {走|はし}る (run) · polite present
questions.explanation: {走|はし}る is an う-verb (godan): る → り (い-row) for the ます-stem, then add the ending → **走ります**. ⚠ {走|はし}る ends in -iる like a る-verb, but it is one of the う-verb exceptions.
questions.translation: I run in the park every morning.

questions.prompt:
{毎晩|まいばん}11{時|じ}に（　）。
→ {寝|ね}る (sleep) · polite present
questions.explanation: {寝|ね}る is a る-verb (ichidan): drop る for the ます-stem, then add the ending → **寝ます**.
questions.translation: I go to bed at eleven every night.

questions.prompt:
{授業中|じゅぎょうちゅう}に（　）はいけません。
→ {喋|しゃべ}る (chat) · て-form
questions.explanation: {喋|しゃべ}る is an う-verb (godan): う・つ・る → って → **喋って**. ⚠ {喋|しゃべ}る ends in -eる like a る-verb, but it is one of the う-verb exceptions.

questions.prompt:
{凍|こお}った{道|みち}で（　）、{転|ころ}んでしまった。
→ {滑|すべ}る (slip) · て-form
questions.explanation: {滑|すべ}る is an う-verb (godan): う・つ・る → って → **滑って**. ⚠ {滑|すべ}る ends in -eる like a る-verb, but it is one of the う-verb exceptions.
questions.translation: I slipped on the icy road and fell.

questions.prompt:
{時間|じかん}はあるから、（　）でゆっくりやって。
→ {焦|あせ}る (rush, panic) · plain negative
questions.explanation: {焦|あせ}る is an う-verb (godan): る → ら (あ-row) + ない → **焦らない**. ⚠ {焦|あせ}る ends in -eる like a る-verb, but it is one of the う-verb exceptions.
questions.translation: There's time, so don't rush — take it slowly.

questions.prompt:
{先月|せんげつ}より{体重|たいじゅう}が2キロ（　）。
→ {減|へ}る (decrease) · plain past
questions.explanation: {減|へ}る is an う-verb (godan): う・つ・る → って → **減った**. ⚠ {減|へ}る ends in -eる like a る-verb, but it is one of the う-verb exceptions.
questions.translation: I've lost two kilos since last month.

questions.prompt:
{電車|でんしゃ}を（　）、{駅|えき}まで{歩|ある}いた。
→ {降|お}りる (get off) · て-form
questions.explanation: {降|お}りる is a る-verb (ichidan): drop る + て / た → **降りて**.
questions.translation: I got off the train and walked to the station.
